properties.name: A claim supported by several lines reads the assumptions of each line, holding under any one of them, and a step citing it inherits only what its chosen line needs
properties.statement:
When a claim holds by several lines, each resting on different open assumptions, its reading names every line's assumption set: it holds under A, or under B, or under C. It never shows only the first. A step that cites the claim inherits the weakest assumption set that still supports it, never another line's assumption.
MEASURED 2026-10-19 in the trolley trial (0.87.0): "Driver: steering permissible" is supported by five principles, yet reads "conditional on act consequentialism" only. A Thomson-2008 step citing the shared position "switch-turn-impermissible" inherited Foot's assumption from the other line. This bears on PR #772's open-assumption fixes (items 0 and 0b): it should be checked whether that PR already reads per line.
